Inside a messy apartment sits Detective Mason. Six months have passed since the divorce was finalised, and still he has not been able to see his daughter.
His lawyer calls to tell him his wife is now demanding 90% of everything he owns. This makes him laugh as he thinks about how he hopes to retire on the last 10%.
But the truth is, Mason is already married to the job.

He carries her basket downstairs. For a moment, helping someone is enough.
